periods.time: Shortly after Akatsuki begins confronting Hagun

name.zh: 南乡救出加加美并发出警告
name.en: Nango rescues Kagami and she warns Ikki

periods.location: Kyoumon training camp warehouse / Hagun emergency call link
periods.summary: Nango senses someone inside a warehouse at the emptied training camp and cuts the lock, finding Kagami bound and gagged. Kagami immediately tries to call Ikki, Stella and Shizuku, then uses an emergency student-handbook broadcast to shout that Alice is a spy from another school. Her warning reaches Hagun just as the planned clash begins.
periods.cause: Alice hid Kagami in a remote warehouse after stabbing her; Nango's exceptional senses detect her presence.
periods.outcome: The warning arrives too late to prevent the battlefield setup, but it confirms Alice's danger at the key instant.
periods.significance: Bridges Kagami's investigation to the main battle and shows how close Akatsuki came to flawless surprise.
